comment: Asset keys the shim pre-loads through __crcbl_web_fetch_* before the demo boots. viewer's are the shelf's Suzanne — the document the tab opens on, per docs/plan/sample/05-viewer.md milestone 4 — in the separate .gltf + .bin + textures form, so the sibling-key resolution the asset seam exists to do is what a page exercises too. Only Suzanne is pre-loaded: the other models the site carries are fetched when the ESC panel's SHELF row is stepped onto them, because everything listed here is time a visitor spends on a loading message before the first frame. tools/fetch-shelf.sh is what puts the files under assets/shelf/, at a pinned upstream commit with a sha256 each; web/build.sh calls it. A document the visitor chooses does not come through here either: it is dropped on the canvas and pushed straight into wasm memory by web/demos/viewer/main.js, so it is never a key and never fetched. The list is the seam, not the content.
